entries.title: JournalEvent
entries.summary: Sealed hierarchie 6 typů událostí v append-only journalu (přejmenováno z LedgerEvent v Stage A doménového refactoru). Každá nese deterministický eventKey — re-zápis stejného eventu je no-op (set() v Firestore, composite unique v Isaru). Žije v lib/domain/journal/ a používá package:meta místo flutter/foundation, aby splnila domain purity guard.

entries.title: Journal (abstract aggregate)
entries.summary: Read-only doménová abstrakce nad ledger storage. Nahrazuje přímé volání repository query metod z application vrstvy — providers / projekce čtou přes Journal facade, append zůstává repository concern. Scaffold landl v Phase 2; konzumenti migrují inkrementálně přes strangler-fig pattern.

entries.title: PeriodKey (UTC-enforced VO)
entries.summary: Value object pro time-window klíče v Journal eventech (yyyy-MM-dd den, yyyy-Www ISO týden, lifetime, chapter:id). Konstrukce výhradně přes named factories, které normalizují DateTime na UTC. Adresuje cross-TZ collision risk z deeper auditu — dva přístroje v různých zónách na stejný UTC den teď produkují identický key.

entries.title: Progression catalog identifier hierarchy
entries.summary: Sedm extension type wrappers pro String ids v progression / objective / cosmetic katalozích. Tři implementují umbrella ProgressionEntryId (QuestId, AchievementId, MilestoneId) — generic API (Journal.eventsForNode) přijímá libovolný. ChapterId + ObjectiveId zůstávají separate namespaces, CosmeticId žije feature-locally v lib/features/cosmetics/domain/ids.dart. Všech sedm `implements String` — typed wrapper IS-A String, takže typed → String passing nevyžaduje .raw cascade. Reverse směr (String → typed) blokovan kompilátorem, takže authoring sites musí explicitně konstruovat. Zero runtime overhead.

entries.title: Player (aggregate root)
entries.summary: Immutable value object aggregating per-user durable state (uid, level, totalXp, joinedAt, rpgModeEnabled, displayName, photoUrl). Single-player app — neexistuje globální Context aggregate, kompozice se děje ve widget stromu (ChangeNotifierProxyProvider2). Phase 5 přepnula source-of-truth: Player.level + Player.totalXp jsou teď computed z Journal eventů přes statickou factory Player.fromJournal(uid, rewardGrants, levelCurve, ...) — sumuje XP přes RewardGrantEvent.xpAmount kde rewardKind == xp, aplikuje LevelCurve.resolve. Stejnou factory volá i ProgressionEngineProvider.EngineProfile getter (přes Player.totalXpFromGrants), takže oba konzumenti dělí jediné canonical computation. Žádný cycle, žádný drift. joinedAt zatím pořád ze SharedPreferences cache v engine provideru — Journal-derived join lands later. Phase 6+ začnou Player number číst (lifecycles, projections); zatím je to surface API.

entries.title: PlayerQuestLifecycle (sealed)
entries.summary: Phase 6 zavedla sealed lifecycle pro Quest catalog rows: 4 podtypy (QuestLocked / QuestAvailable / QuestCompletedPendingClaim / QuestClaimed) místo bag-of-booleans (isCompleted / isAvailableForClaim / isLockedByConditions) na EngineQuestProgress. Widget consumeři (engine_quest_card, engine_completed_quest_card, engine_chapter_card, engine_long_term_card, quests_screen filters) pattern-matchují přes exhaustive switch — compiler vynutí pokrytí všech 4 stavů a budoucí 5. podtyp ihned chytne každý widget. Bridge mezi old flags a new sealed type je getter EngineQuestProgress.lifecycle; precedence (Locked > Claimed > PendingClaim > Available) je pinned tabulkou v test/domain/progression/player/player_quest_lifecycle_test.dart pokrývající všech 2^3=8 boolean kombinací. NodeState enum + Achievement / Chapter cesty zůstávají beze změny (Phase 8 / 13). QuestLocked.remaining payload je v Phase 6 prázdný (UnlockCondition zatím žije v features/, nikoliv v lib/domain/, takže by porušil layering rule); plný condition slice landne až s catalog rename do domain.

entries.title: PlayerQuest (read projection unit)
entries.summary: Phase 7 immutable value object binding a typed QuestId, a sealed PlayerQuestLifecycle, a DateTime evaluatedAt. Projection unit of PlayerQuestCatalog. Value-based equals + copyWith. Proposal §2.4 specifies `PlayerQuest { Quest quest; ... }`, ale Quest catalog row pořád žije v lib/features/progression_engine/ a lib/domain/ ho nemůže importovat (purity guard); narrower QuestId reference je dnešní proposal-aligned substitut. Konzumenty application + presentation vrstvy resolvují plný Quest catalog row přes ProgressionEntryCatalog.definitionForId(...). Shape se rozšíří až Quest přejde do lib/domain/progression/catalog/.

entries.title: PlayerQuestCatalog (read projection collection)
entries.summary: Phase 7 read projection: Map<QuestId, PlayerQuest> wrapped immutably (entries jsou Map.unmodifiable). Phase 8 (PlayerAchievementShelf) + Phase 13 (ChapterLifecycle) build na stejném vzoru.

entries.title: PlayerAchievementLifecycle (sealed, 3 stavy)
entries.summary: Phase 8 sealed lifecycle pro Achievement catalog rows. 3 podtypy: AchievementLocked / AchievementInProgress (actual, target) / AchievementUnlocked (finalXp, unlockedAt). Žádný PendingClaim stav — V2 achievementy mají ClaimPolicy.automatic per proposal §4.2, takže přechod InProgress → Unlocked je atomický v rámci jednoho eval cycle. Bridge mezi old EngineAchievementView flags (unlocked / isLockedByConditions) a new sealed type je getter EngineAchievementView.lifecycle (mirror Phase 6 EngineQuestProgress.lifecycle). Precedence: Unlocked > Locked > InProgress — JINÁ než quest precedence (Locked > Claimed > PendingClaim > Available) protože achievementy se nikdy nere-lockují (idempotent completion event). Pinned 4-row mapping table v test/features/progression_engine/engine_achievement_view_lifecycle_test.dart. AchievementLocked.remaining payload (proposal §4.2 navrhuje List<UnlockCondition>) je v Phase 8 prázdný — UnlockCondition pořád žije v lib/features/, plný condition slice landne až s catalog rename.

Application/presentation konzumenti resolvují plný catalog row přes ProgressionEntryCatalog.definitionForId(...).

entries.title: PlayerAchievementShelf (read projection collection)
entries.summary: Phase 8 read projection: Map<AchievementId, PlayerAchievement> wrapped immutably. Konzumenty: ProgressionEngineProvider.playerAchievementShelf getter (lazy cache (identityHashCode(_ledger), _devDayOffset)). Accessors: byId / all / length / isEmpty / contains; lifecycle filters locked / inProgress / unlocked + unlockedCount; bucket slice among(ids); ad-hoc where(predicate). Phase 8 service bere primitives (catalog + completed/locked sets + objective lookups + XP scaler), ne EngineAchievementView, protože view nese AppLocalizations dependency kterou provider nemá. Decoupled cleanly: shelf = lifecycle state, view = lifecycle state + display data.

entries.title: PlayerCosmeticLifecycle (4 stavy) + Inventory
entries.summary: Phase 10 sealed lifecycle pro per-player cosmetic stav: CosmeticHidden / CosmeticTeased(satisfied, total, rows) / CosmeticClaimable(claimVia) / CosmeticOwned(unlockedAt, source, sourceId). Mapping z předchozích paralelních enumů: CosmeticRevealState.hidden → CosmeticHidden, .visibleLocked → CosmeticTeased(progress=0), .partial → CosmeticTeased(hasProgress=true), .unlocked → CosmeticOwned. Companion-specific Claimable přidává čtvrtý stav (engine availableNodeIds.contains(id)). Identity-hide pravidlo pro companions není state, ale derivace přes top-level hidesIdentity(Cosmetic, PlayerCosmeticLifecycle) helper per proposal §4.3. Inventory aggregate = Map<CosmeticId, PlayerCosmetic> read projection vystavený přes CosmeticsProvider.buildInventory(claimableNodeIds). Phase 11 smazala paralelní CompanionState enum + CompanionsRegistry factory — UI nyní pattern-matchuje výhradně na (Cosmetic catalog, PlayerCosmeticLifecycle). Zbylá companion-specific lookup (availability node pro claim flow + devtools matrix) žije v companion_availability_lookup.dart jako pure top-level funkce.

entries.title: ChapterLifecycle + PlayerChapterProgress + Chapter catalog wrapper
entries.summary: Phase 13 sealed lifecycle pro chapter stav (proposal §4.4): ChapterLocked / ChapterUnlockedNotStarted(unlockedAt) / ChapterInProgress(currentChainNodeId, stepsCompleted, stepsTotal) / ChapterCompleted(completedAt). Stejný read-projection pattern jako Phase 7 PlayerQuestCatalog + Phase 8 PlayerAchievementShelf — PlayerChapter VO drží ChapterId reference + lifecycle; PlayerChapterProgress collection wrapuje immutable Map<ChapterId, PlayerChapter>. Chapter catalog wrapper (lib/domain/progression/catalog/chapter.dart) agreguje chain entries (opener / steps / finale / optional completion / side-quests) přes id-only references — žádný cross-feature import potřeba. ChapterCatalogBuilder + PlayerChapterProgressService žijí v lib/features/progression_engine/application/ a building bere primitives (completedNodeIds + lockedNodeIds + earliestCompletionAt closure). Phase 13 zároveň smazala lib/features/progression_engine/domain/models/node_state.dart — NodeState enum přesunutý do resolveru jako internal state-machine vocabulary (.name strings keep engine consumer working).

entries.title: EngineEvaluationContext + LedgerCounters + EvaluationOverrides (engine arg bundle)
entries.summary: Phase 16 nahradil flat `EngineEvaluationInput` record strukturovanými VO bundling 8 typed inputs co engine konzumuje: Player + HealthSnapshot + NutritionSnapshot + GoalBoard + Journal + LedgerCounters + EvaluationOverrides + evaluatedAt. LedgerCounters (lib/features/progression_engine/domain/models/ledger_counters.dart) drží journal-derived aggregations (totalRewardCount, rewardCountByRule, bestStreakByDomain, bestRollingStepsByDays, nodeCompletionCounts, comboPoolCompletionCounts, totalQuestCompletions, questCompletionsByBucket, distinctActiveDays, nodesCompletedToday) — provider-side derivation logic v ProgressionEngineProvider._buildLedgerCounters() (Phase 20 JournalProjection později přesune derivation do Journal). EvaluationOverrides (lib/features/progression_engine/domain/models/evaluation_overrides.dart) drží runtime provider-state overrides (dnes jen objectiveActualOverrides pro chapter-step baselines). EngineEvaluationContext slouží jako internal helper bundle pro sub-evaluators (ObjectiveEvaluator, ProgressionNodeResolver, UnlockConditionResolver, RewardGrantPlanner přijímají ho jako single arg). Public ProgressionEngine.evaluate() signature je structured named args (player, healthSnapshot, nutritionSnapshot, goalBoard, journal, counters, overrides, evaluatedAt) per migration plan §Phase 16 — no flat record between provider and evaluator. Internally engine.evaluate() builds context once a passes dolů přes _evaluateWithContext(). Plus claim() + simulateClaim() + simulateObjectiveMet() všechny mají identický 8-arg signature shape. Journal interface dostal in-memory adapter (lib/domain/journal/in_memory_journal.dart) wrapping List<JournalEvent>; engine zatím internally reads ledger via repository.loadLedger() (strangler-fig per follow_ups.md §2.13). ProgressionResolutionResult.inputSnapshot → contextSnapshot field rename. Side-by-side test verification: stejné ObjectiveCompletionEvent / NodeCompletionEvent / RewardGrantEvent emise pro identical seed inputs pre vs post-refactor.

entries.title: HealthSnapshot + NutritionSnapshot (engine-input read projections)
entries.summary: Phase 15 pure-Dart immutable snapshots wrapping FitnessProvider / KalorickeTabulkyProvider read surfaces co engine evaluator konzumuje. HealthSnapshot (lib/features/health_connect/domain/health_snapshot.dart) drží evaluatedDate + stepsToday / stepsThisWeek / stepsLifetime / sleepMinutesToday / activityMinutesToday / weightLoggedToday. NutritionSnapshot (lib/features/nutrition/domain/nutrition_snapshot.dart) drží evaluatedDate + caloriesToday / proteinGramsToday / carbsGramsToday / fatGramsToday / fiberGramsToday. Oba const constructible s value-based equality + copyWith + signature getter (stable string fingerprint pro change detection). FitnessProvider.snapshotForDate(date) walks stepsHistory / activities / weight history / sleep history once a fabricates anchored snapshot — pre-extraction _stepsThisWeek / _stepsLifetime / _activityMinutesForDay helpers přesunuté z ProviderEngineInputSource do providera. KalorickeTabulkyProvider.snapshotForDate(date) reads _db.getDay(date) (fallback _today cache pro active-day pre-sync state), tagne with caller date. ProviderEngineInputSource.buildInput čte přes `fitness.snapshotForDate(today)` + `nutrition.snapshotForDate(today)` namísto field-by-field provider gettrů — engine evaluator path už neimportuje raw provider state. auditSignature joinuje snapshot.signature + goal scalars. Phase 16 nahradí flat EngineEvaluationInput tímto snapshot + Player + GoalBoard arg listem; Phase 15 ships snapshot types + provider fabricators bez breaking call site change (input shape stejný).

entries.title: GoalBoard + PlayerGoal (per-Player goals with revision history)
entries.summary: Phase 14 extrakce per-Player goalů z GoalsProvider mixed-state do domain layeru. GoalMetric enum (9 metrik: dailySteps / targetWeight / dailyCalories / dailyProtein / dailyFat / dailyCarbs / dailyFiber / sleepHours / weeklyActivityMins) + GoalRevision VO (effectiveFrom date-only + value) + PlayerGoal entity (metric + current target + List<GoalRevision> history). GoalBoard collection wrapuje Map<GoalMetric, PlayerGoal>. Persistence beze změny — SharedPreferences keys `goal_<metric>` (scalar target) + `goal_<metric>_history` (JSON revision list) match the pre-extraction wire format byte-for-byte; targetWeight nemá historii (single current value). PlayerGoal.resolveForDate(day) vrací target effective on day pro retroactive backfill evaluation (latest revision <= day, fallback to history.first). PlayerGoal.ensureRevisionAt(anchor, currentValue) je no-op když resolution už matchne — používáno init() pro fixup stale future-dated revisions. GoalBoard.progressionHistorySignature vylučuje targetWeight a slouží jako cache-invalidation pro ProgressionProvider.signature. GoalsProvider zůstává jako thin façade (ChangeNotifier + SharedPreferences I/O); všechny existující gettery (`.dailySteps`, `.dailyCalories`, ...) + setters + `progression*ForDate(day)` API delegují na board — žádný consumer není breaking.
